title: Helicopters escorting UFOs into mountains

tellings.quote: The fact that you have helicopters escorting some of these UFOs and UAPs into the mountains,

plain: Helicopters have been seen escorting some UFOs and UAP, the government's term for unexplained flying objects, into the mountains. Michels says this himself, without naming where or when, while talking with the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch known for strange happenings, and if true it would mean someone on the ground knows about these craft and guides them somewhere.
